mechanism_limits: Earlier b2 release and larger following wait may advance Z but restore O-bubbles; source raw-rail headroom is not decoder readiness or analog-settling proof

overlap_diagnostic.limits: Diagnostic only; original84bit comparator-read and12code/CM gates are unchanged
overlap_diagnostic.opposite_rail_scope: Only initially classifiable boundaries; initial None is unassessable, never evidence of stable polarity

acceptance_gap_diagnostic.limits: Final trailing rail-command run is observed only through the existing next-read window; half-VDD and rail commands do not prove analog settling or switch conduction

selected_parser.basic_measurement_parse: Separate inherited measurement pass; not included in summary count
